utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everybody in and around the courtroom. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon Your Honours, good afternoon everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much, could we have the appearances for the day starting with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THOMAS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours, good afternoon everybody in and around the courtroom. Mark Harmon, Barney Thomas, and Carmela Javier for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much and for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everyone. Milos Androvic, Tina Drolec, Daniela Tasic, Chad Mair, Novak Lukic, and Gregor Guy-Smith on behalf of Mr. Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Guy-Smith. Mr. Thomas.

utterances.speaker: MR. THOMAS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours, if we could please go into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we are back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The Chamber stands adjourned to tomorrow at quarter past 2.00. Courtroom I. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 14th day of May, 2009, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.02 p.m.
